name: Rust-Server
description: Fully customizable Rust Server at your fingertips. Set all of the settings below to suit your needs and save when you are ready. Features: Automatic updating system with wipe. Auto Port forwarding (UPnP). Simple Template for faster setup (Great for newbies). Auto announcements, upto 5 messages to set. Enable option to show wiped date in server title.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: 1 = Yes /br 0 = No /br Be accessible online. /br Will automatically port forward your router. (UPnP)

variables.name: PVE
variables.description: 1 = Enabled (Player Vs Entities) /br 0 = Disabled (Player Vs Player)

variables.name: Auto Maintenance
variables.description: 1 = Yes /br 0 = No /br Automatically updates server/oxide and manages wipes. /br Will notify players before update happens.

variables.name: Auto Wipe
variables.description: Leave (BLANK) for no server wipes. /br Enter the amount of days until server wipes. /br Example.. 7 will wipe the server 7 days after the map was created. /br Players will be notified before wipe.

variables.name: Wipe Date On Title
variables.description: 1 = Enabled /br 0 = Disabled /br Will show the the server wiped date in the server name.

variables.name: Oxide Plugin
variables.description: 1 = Enabled /br 0 = Disable /br Be able to install plugins from Oxide.

variables.name: Performance
variables.description: 1 = Resource Friendly (Optimized) /br 2 = Original (Rust Default Settings) /br 3 = Competitive (Resource Gobbler)

variables.name: Server Release
variables.description: public = (Latest update) /br prerelease = (Under development)

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Enter the server name. /br This is the name that will show up in Rust server list.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: The information about the server. /br This will be shown when this server is selected in rust server list. /br Use \n for new line.

variables.name: Banner URL
variables.description: Banner must be 512x256 PNG

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Max amount of players that can join.

variables.name: Map Size
variables.description: tiny | small /br medium | large /br massive

variables.name: Rcon Password
variables.description: Password to access Rcon (Remote Console) /br Leave blank for unsecure login (Not Recommended)

variables.name: (ADVANCED) Extra Startup Arguments
variables.description: Extra rust arguments to be applied when starting up server.

variables.name: Announce 1
variables.description: Leave BLANK to disable announcements. /br Enter announcement in order 1-5. /br Not all announcements must be filled

variables.name: Announce 2
variables.description: ANNOUNCEMENT 2

variables.name: Announce 3
variables.description: ANNOUNCEMENT 3

variables.name: Announce 4
variables.description: ANNOUNCEMENT 4

variables.name: Announce 5
variables.description: ANNOUNCEMENT 5

variables.name: Port Forward Web
variables.description: Match this port with (Web Port)

variables.name: Port Forward Rust
variables.description: Match this port with (Rust Port)

variables.name: Port Forward Rcon
variables.description: Match this port with (Rcon Port)

variables.name: Map Seed
variables.description: 0 = Randomises the map terrain etc.. /br Or enter your own value if you want a consistent map on each wipe.

variables.name: Server Folder Name
variables.description: Server folder name, e.g My-server-name

variables.name: Save Intervals
variables.description: Value is in seconds.

variables.name: Announce Delay
variables.description: Delay in minutes between each announcement.
